description: This file contains unit tests for the `GatewayLaunchAgentManager` component of the OpenClaw project. Specifically, it tests parsing of property list snapshots related to launch agent configurations, including handling of environment variables and optional parameters.

classes.name: GatewayLaunchAgentManagerTests
classes.description: A struct containing test functions for verifying the correct parsing of launch agent property list snapshots.

methods.name: launch agent plist snapshot parses args and env
methods.description: Tests that a plist with program arguments and environment variables is correctly parsed, extracting port, bind address, token, and password.

methods.name: launch agent plist snapshot allows missing bind
methods.description: Tests that a plist with only program arguments (missing bind address) is handled correctly, with bind set to nil.
